audience: support teams that answer customer conversations in Dixa

useCases.title: Search conversations and read the thread
useCases.text: Search conversations by subject or message text. Read the messages and the internal notes of one conversation.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their history
useCases.text: Find end users by email, phone or external id. List the conversations of one customer before you reply.

useCases.title: Check agent presence and queues
useCases.text: See which agents are online now. Read the queues and teams that route conversations to them.

useCases.title: Check whether the business is open
useCases.text: List the business hours schedules. Check whether one schedule is open now or at a given time.

useCases.title: Add a note, a tag or a status change
useCases.text: Add an internal note that customers do not see. Add or remove a tag, or close a conversation.
